Asha (CS): quick capture from Volt onboarding. renewal checkpoint ~5w. They surfaced four asks that impact procurement + go-live. Posting for triage.

Asha (CS): raw asks: 1) monthly CSV export of per-route token usage + cost for finance. 2) per-route embedding TTL override (shorter for dev). 3) explicit KMS/service-account verification step in onboarding (customers stall). 4) console warn at 80% reserved capacity.

Evan (PM): impact notes?

Asha (CS): CSV = high (procurement needs it), TTL = medium, KMS step = high (blocks go-live), 80% warn = medium. Customer said finance won't finalize without exports.

Diego (Eng): feasibility quick: CSV = small-medium (usage aggregator + CSV endpoint), TTL override = small (route config), KMS verification = small but needs security signoff, capacity warn = small.

Evan (PM): triage suggestion: P0 = CSV export + KMS onboarding check; P1 = capacity warn; P2 = TTL override. Agree?

Rae (SE): workaround for CSV: share this one-liner until we ship CSV:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=volt&group_by=route&start=2026-08-01&end=2026-08-31" \n  | jq -r '.routes[] | [.route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > volt-aug-route-costs.csv
```

Maya (Enablement): I can run a 30m assisted onboarding tomorrow 10am PT to walk them through KMS steps and share the CSV script. Can product add checklist text to the onboarding modal as short-term copy/paste?

Diego (Eng): I'll slot a 2d spike for KMS verification + security Monday and post findings here.

Asha (CS): customer update plan: enablement call + manual CSV workaround; product to prioritize KMS spike. Volt replied :relieved: and will wait for the follow-up before signing.

triage-bot: reminder: create ticket "onboarding: KMS verification + CSV export" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
